subject: Initial product tour — availability, attendee roles & quick checklist
thread_text:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lumitech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial product tour — availability, attendee roles & quick checklist

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you and the team on the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a 30-min intro/demo and make sure the right people are on the call:

Recap (30s):
- Primary use case: Lumitech wants a predictable, low-latency inference layer for search re-ranking and product descriptions, with strict audit trails.
- Key constraints: data residency (US), SOC 2 evidence, and a 99.9% inference SLA for peak windows.
- Stakeholders identified: Product (you), Head of Engineering (Carlos), Security/Compliance (tbd).

Proposed next step: 30-minute product tour + quick technical Q&A. Please confirm which of these 3 windows works best for Carlos + your product lead + (optional) security contact — we’ll keep it focused and include a short tech agenda for Carlos:
- Option A: Tue, Nov 2 — 09:00–09:30 PT
- Option B: Wed, Nov 3 — 11:00–11:30 PT
- Option C: Thu, Nov 4 — 14:00–14:30 PT

If none of the above fit, tell me two windows that do and we’ll swap. I’ve attached a one-page overview of Redwood’s hosted + dedicated options for quick context.

Pre-reads / ask from your side (helps the 30-min run rate):
- Confirm who will join from your side (names + roles) so we bring the right Redwood engineers.
- If security will join, can they share any must-have compliance docs (SOC 2 scope questions) or we can share our redacted summary ahead of time.

I’ll loop Marissa (Solutions) on the follow-up to handle the technical agenda and the demo flow.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: product-one-pager.pdf (1 page, PDF)

--
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lumitech.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@lumitech.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial product tour — availability, attendee roles & quick checklist

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the recap. Wed Nov 3 11:00–11:30 PT (Option B) looks good for Carlos and me. I’ve copied Carlos on this thread — he’s Lumitech’s Head of Engineering.

A couple of asks before we lock the invite:
- Can you share a short tech agenda that covers the runtime, expected latency under batch and prefix-caching assumptions, and model variant fallback behavior? Carlos wants to see how Redwood would handle a gradual rollout of a custom re-ranker.
- Security: we need a SOC 2 summary (redacted ok) + a short note on data retention options. If you can attach the SOC2 summary ahead of the meeting, that would speed things up.

I’ll also invite our product manager (TBD) — will confirm the third attendee by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Alyssa
Sr. Product Manager | Lumitech
alyssa@lumitech.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

--
From: Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lumitech.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos@lumitech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial product tour — availability, attendee roles & quick checklist

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Alyssa. Wed Nov 3, 11:00–11:30 PT is locked on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite once Carlos confirms the attendee list.

Quick tech agenda (30 min):
1) 0–6m: short product tour + where Redwood fits in (hosted vs. dedicated)
2) 6–16m: runtime deep dive — caching/kv-prefix behavior and quantization tradeoffs
3) 16–24m: rollout patterns + model variant fallback and routing policies
4) 24–30m: quick Q&A on latency SLAs and next steps (pilot sizing)

Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted) and the earlier one-pager. The SOC2 doc includes a short section on retention controls and encryption + KMS notes. If Carlos wants deeper notes, Marissa can prepare a short appendix for the technical deep dive.

Calendar invite (tentative): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-lumitech-demo — I’ll convert to a confirmed invite once Carlos confirms final attendee list.

Marissa — can you please add two bullets to the deck: a) expected latency numbers for re-ranking at 256 token contexts (p50/p95) across hosted/dedicated, and b) our recommended staging -> canary -> full rollout for a re-ranker? I’ll share the one-pager and SOC summary in the invite.

Ben — FYI in case we want to propose a small pilot pricing structure later this week.

Thanks all,
Priyom

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (2 pages, PDF); product-one-pager.pdf (1 page, PDF)

--
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@lumitech.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lumitech.com>, Priyom Das <pri_yom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial product tour — availability, attendee roles & quick checklist

Thanks — Wed 11:00 PT works for me. I’ll join and bring context on our re-ranker rollout plan. No additional security attendees on our side for the initial call.

See you then,
Carlos
Head of Engineering | Lumitech
carlos@lumitech.com
